category_definitions.Wellness: Products or services explicitly for physical fitness, exercise, or health, including gym memberships and identified fitness trackers. General consumer electronics and unspecified lifestyle subscriptions do not qualify merely because they might be used during exercise.
category_definitions.Smartphone: A smartphone handset. Excludes tablets, watches, headphones, other accessories, and mobile service charges.
category_definitions.Broadband: Fixed home or office internet service charges; excludes mobile service and purchases of devices.
category_definitions.Mobile Bill: Cellular voice or mobile data service charges; excludes devices and fixed broadband.
category_definitions.Business Hotel: Hotel or other temporary lodging service. Classify the service type only; do not infer or require a business purpose.
category_definitions.Business Transport: Passenger travel service such as taxi, rail, bus, or airfare. Classify the service type only; do not infer or require a business purpose.
category_definitions.OTHER: The item is identifiable and falls outside all six reimbursement categories.
category_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: The description does not identify the product or service well enough to choose a category or OTHER. Do not infer a particular product from a brand name alone.

note: Hypotheses are development assumptions, not measured Jev performance. One observation per case; no accuracy or latency benchmark is claimed.
